name: Huerquehue: Los Lagos trail
why: A steep climb through coigüe and araucaria forest past two waterfalls to a plateau of still lakes, with Villarrica volcano behind you.
book: Park ticket in advance at pasesparques.cl. From Pucón take the road to Caburgua and the signed turn at Paillaco; the last 8 km are gravel. Local buses run from Pucón.
water: Streams and the lakes; treat it. Nothing to buy after the Tinquilco ranger post.
dangers: The climb above Lago Tinquilco is steep, with stairs and roots, slippery after rain.
Snow on the plateau from June to September.
The loop paths on the plateau split often: follow the signs to Lago Chico for the way down.
turnaround: Not at Lago Chico by 13:00: see Lago Chico and Lago Verde and go back down.

points.name: Lago Tinquilco trailhead
points.note: At the end of the road by Lago Tinquilco. The trail follows the shore, then climbs steeply past the Trufulco and Nido de Águila waterfalls.

points.name: Lago Chico
points.note: The first lake, at the top of the climb, with araucarias on the far shore.

points.name: Lago Toro
points.note: The largest lake of the plateau, ringed by araucarias and lenga.

points.name: Laguna Huerquehue
points.note: The far end of the loop; the path turns back west past Laguna de los Patos.

points.name: Lago Verde
points.note: A small green lake just above Lago Chico. From here the same trail leads back down to Tinquilco.
